OUR PRACTICE

Different ideas, different ways of making.

Every collaboration begins with listening. We seek to understand each artist’s intention and explore the possibilities of their project together.

From sound and interactive experiences to artwork production, we combine experimentation and technical work to help ideas take shape. Based in Mexico City, we work in dialogue with different practices and contexts.

Capabilities and services
Sound and technical production for concerts

Audio equipment and backline rental, with technical production for experimental and electroacoustic music concerts and cultural events.

View service
Art and new media production

Production of artworks using digital technologies, interactive systems, and electronic devices.

3D printing

Filament 3D printing for functional parts, artworks, and installations, with multicolour options and formats up to 30 × 30 × 60 cm.
